calls.reasoning: Resolution is effectively a two-coin race: on CoinGecko (2026-10-05 16:28 UTC) ZEC is #10 at $21.83B, HYPE #11 at $20.59B (~6% gap); #9 FIGR_HELOC $25.0B is stable-priced, #12 DOGE $14.7B is far below. Base rate from a random-walk model: ~6% log gap vs ~20% 10-day relative vol of the ZEC/HYPE ratio gives ~0.58-0.60 for keeping the spot. Adjusted down for HYPE's early-October unlocks (more circulating supply mechanically raises its market cap), ZEC's -15.6% 7d momentum vs HYPE +6% near its ATH, and HYPE revenue buybacks. Counterweight: ZEC's very high volatility cuts both ways, and it is still +28% over 30d. No human prediction market found on Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold or bookmakers.
